title: Apple Launches iOS 27.3 Beta With Alibaba-Powered Filter for China AI

tickers.name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited American Depositary Shares, each represents eight Ordinary Shares

summary:
The tech giant's latest software preview for developers brings its AI capabilities to the Chinese market through a limited trial that utilizes a content filter provided by Alibaba. This iOS 27.3 beta also introduces expanded global support for the revamped Health app, which will roll out as a free update later in 2026 with support for 11 languages, including Vietnamese, Turkish, and Portuguese.

The update includes the addition of Reachability for the iPhone Duo, fulfilling a feature promise made prior to the device's launch, along with interface adjustments to iMessage and the keyboard to improve content display. Other tests in the beta include conversation-summarizing tools for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, as well as Visual Intelligence support for the Apple Pencil on iPadOS, with the full public release coming in December.
